create.name: Decorah Zen Center
create.bio:
Decorah Zen Center is a lay Soto Zen practice place in the small college town of Decorah, in north-east Iowa. It runs as a project of Ryumonji Zen Monastery in the nearby hills, and members who want to go deeper are encouraged to take part in the monastery's residential training. The officiating priest is Rev. Myoko Laura Demuth, who was ordained by Shoken Winecoff in 2013, received Dharma transmission from him in 2016 and continues to practise at Ryumonji; she directs the centre together with Lee Ekai Zook.

The centre's aim is a steady, local rhythm of sitting. Zazen is held on weekday mornings, with an extra late-afternoon sitting on Mondays and a Wednesday evening sitting followed by a Dharma talk; newcomers are asked to come a little early for a short orientation. There is no fee, and offerings are left to each person. Alongside meditation, the centre offers instruction in zazen, study of Buddhist history and texts, workshops and discussion, and it shares the texts of many of its talks freely online, from an introduction to meditation and a four-part look at the Heart Sutra to series on the precepts and the seven factors of awakening.

courses.title: Zazen at Decorah Zen Center
courses.description: Sitting meditation on weekday mornings, a Monday late-afternoon sitting and a Wednesday evening sitting with a Dharma talk afterwards. First-timers are given a short orientation if they arrive early.

free_resources.title: Introduction to Meditation
free_resources.description: The written text of a centre talk that compares several kinds of meditation, Buddhist and otherwise, to show what sets Zen sitting apart. Free to read online.

free_resources.title: DZC Intro to the Heart Sutra I
free_resources.description: First of four talk texts on the Heart Sutra, covering where the sutra comes from and what its full title means, word by word. Free to read online.
